description:
Pradhan Mantri Garib Kalyan Yojana (PMGKY) is a welfare scheme launched by the Government of India. 

It was introduced in March 2020 in response to the economic impact of the COVID-19 pandemic. 

The primary objective is to provide financial assistance and support to the poor and vulnerable sections of society. 

The scheme aims to ensure food security and provide direct cash transfers to help individuals and families during the crisis. 

Under PMGKY, beneficiaries receive free food grains for a specified period. 

The scheme also includes cash transfers to women and senior citizens. 

Eligibility is primarily based on being part of the Below Poverty Line (BPL) category. 

The application process is generally automatic for eligible beneficiaries under existing schemes. 

The timeline for benefits is aligned with the duration of the COVID-19 pandemic and subsequent government assessments. 

The Ministry of Finance and the Ministry of Consumer Affairs, Food and Public Distribution are the implementing authorities. 

Additional details include provisions for free cooking gas cylinders and increased wages under the Mahatma Gandhi National Rural Employment Guarantee Act (MGNREGA).
